title: Plastic melted in the dishwasher
text: Plastic melted in the dishwasher. This product is not dishwasher safe. I used it one time and put it in the dishwasher. When it came out the parts were so warped  they wouldn't go together. I put the whole thing in the trash. It a good thing I saved my cheap nesco jerky gun.

description: WHAT'S JERKY?- Beef jerky is a delicious snack made by drying lean, flavorful meat. You can use all sorts of meat for your jerky, including flank steak, sirloin, or filet mignon. To flavor your meat, add seasoning and marinade. Then dry it.- The finished product is protein-rich when you chew it deliciously.- Jerky also makes a savory broth base for soups and stews.WHY BUY IT?- Make homemade jerky with healthier ingredients for friends and family.- Most people tend to make preferred flavors of jerky.- Tired of buying expensive jerky at a grocery or convenience store.HOW TO USE?XINQIAO Beef Jerky Gun Kit helps you make jerky at home quickly. Load up ground meat and twist on a flat or round nozzle.Then squeeze the trigger to release perfectly shaped jerky into your dehydrator trays or jerky racks. It's simple to make homemade snacks. When you finish it, we include two cleaning brushes to make cleanup a breeze. The mechanical system is simplified; thus, you can clean up without remaining meat.PACKAGEJerky Gun: 1 lb capacityNozzle: 4 nozzles (flat/round)Brush: 2 cleaning brushes
